text:
maya: heads up — nightly eval flagged a big quality drop on the instr-summarize promptset for the int8-converted v2 model (seen in last 2 runs). samples look like truncated outputs and repeated partial sentences.

samir: ugh, saw a few of those too. can you paste an example?

maya: example: 
```
User: Summarize the following article.
Model: The economy improved. The economy improved. The economy improved......\n```
and another where stop tokens were ignored (no closing </s>).

liam: run logs show a warning from tokenizer at conversion time: `warning: missing_special_token_map` and later the runtime shows `kv_cache_miss` churn spikes around first tokens. linking logs.

anya: @eval-bot can you dump the eval histogram and the prompt-level failure ids?

eval-bot: nightly_eval v3 results: summary_fail_rate=0.18 (+0.12 vs baseline), stop_token_drop=0.14, repetition_spike=0.22. failing_ids: [4821,4824,4827,4830].

samir: interesting that stop_token_drop correlates with repetition. probable cause: tokenization mapping for special tokens got reindexed during quant conversion -> model sometimes never emits expected stop id so runtime keeps decoding prefix fragments and the KV cache handling gets stressed.

liam: i inspected the model's tokenizer.json vs converted tokenizer: special token ids moved by +1 for tokens with accent marks. this is consistent with the `missing_special_token_map` warning. our int8 conversion script overwrote `tokenizer_config.json` with default mapping.

maya: any sign it's runtime batching or quant kernels?

liam: also found anomalous behavior where prefix caching assumes stop-token-id exists in config; when absent the cache eviction routine keeps reusing partial prefixes. so it's a two-hit: bad tokenizer + cache logic fragile to missing stop id.

anya: TL;DR root cause: conversion script clobbered tokenizer->special token id mapping; runtime's KV prefix caching didn't guard against missing stop id leading to repetition and higher failure rates.

samir: mitigation options: 1) rollback the int8 converted model to previous stable artifact (recommended immediate), 2) patch conversion script to preserve special token map, 3) add guard in runtime to treat missing stop id as fatal-canary, 4) add gating test in nightly eval to check stop token emission and repetition metrics.

maya: agree rollback now. I'll trigger a rollback and pin traffic.

liam: i'll open PR with conversion script fix and add a sanity check that aborts conversion if special-token-map mismatch detected. patch will also include a small conversion unit test. assigned to me, ETA EOD.

anya: i'll add two gating rules to CI/nightly: (a) stop-token pass rate >= 99% on instr-summarize and (b) repetition delta <= 0.05 vs baseline. failing runs should block promoting converted artifacts.

samir: can we also add a runtime defensive change to avoid silent repetition if tokenizer metadata is missing? something like: if stop_id not in vocab -> emit error and fall back to CPU generic decoder.

liam: yep I'll include that as an opt-in fallback in the runtime patch and add a small canary rollout (1% traffic) before full deploy.

maya: rollback command I ran: `deploy rollback --model redwood/v2q-int8 --to sha:7b2c9f`. traffic pinned.

eval-bot: rollback completed. traffic 100% -> sha:7b2c9f. Next nightly eval scheduled in 4h.

anya: created ticket ML-4312: "Preserve tokenizer special_token_map in conversion; add conversion unit test" assigned to liam.

liam: PR draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/convert/pull/214 — includes unit test + abort-if-mismatch. will request review from @samir @maya.

samir: added runtime ticket INF-2248 for defensive missing-stop-id handling + canary plan. assigned to me.

maya: quick follow-ups: 1) schedule a focused eval pass on failing ids after rollback, 2) add a short postmortem note to eng-ml channel once we verify nightly numbers, 3) update onboarding docs for conversion script.

liam: will run focused eval now: `python tools/nightly_eval.py --model /models/sha/7b2c9f --prompts promptsets/instr-summarize.yml --ids 4820-4840 --output /tmp/4820-4840.json`

anya: thanks all. nice triage. capturing action items: rollback (maya), conversion fix + unit test (liam), runtime guard + canary (samir), gating rules (anya), focused re-eval and postmortem (maya).

maya: will post summary in #eng-ml with links to tickets after the focused eval completes. :thumbsup:

samir: one final note — let's also add a small check in model onboarding checklist: `verify special_token_ids stable after conversion` so this doesn't recur.

liam: added to onboarding checklist.

maya: closing thread for now; will re-open if re-eval fails.
